requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Layer metadata returned geometryType esriGeometryPolygon, native spatial reference EPSG:31983 (SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 23S), max record count 2000, and fields including objectid plus unsafe cadastral attributes not requested.

Anonymous point query at the exact WUP coordinate transformed to EPSG:31983 returned an empty FeatureCollection with outFields=objectid and returnGeometry=true. This is an exact-point miss only, not evidence of citywide absence.

Anonymous bounded envelope query centered on the transformed WUP point, approximately 2 km by 2 km, with spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=objectid, resultRecordCount=3, outSR=4326 returned three polygon features (native objectids 55, 118, 140) and exceededTransferLimit=true. Three full polygons were retained with properties reduced to id only.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Rio de Janeiro municipal parcelment layer and related municipal cadastral services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public polygon feature service with anonymous ID+geometry response in a bounded envelope around the WUP point.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Municipal cadastre/map custodian evidenced by Prefeitura do Rio official service and portal.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: Three valid-looking polygon geometries returned by the official GeoJSON query; no topology repair or coordinate shifting performed.
qualityAssessment.crs: Source EPSG:31983 / SIRGAS 2000 UTM zone 23S; retained sample is GeoJSON transformed by service outSR=4326, coordinates longitude/latitude per GeoJSON.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: Native objectid was returned and used as the sole retained properties.id value; stability beyond this service response remains for serial review.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only objectid was requested. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe attributes were requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify municipal coverage, native identity semantics, CRS/axis handling, and anonymous query behavior before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-22.8050293524197,-43.1936610372124] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact point returned zero features; this is not evidence of citywide absence. The bounded envelope returned features elsewhere in the vicinity.
Envelope response exceededTransferLimit=true; retained sample is deliberately limited to three polygons and is not a coverage census.

The WUP label Ribeira may denote a locality/neighborhood rather than an administrative municipality; source scope is the Rio de Janeiro municipal service, and locality matching was not independently resolved.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
identityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON contains exactly one canonical native identity in properties.id. Native field mapping and query provenance are documented here and in service review; no raw source attribute set was retained.

nativeFieldMapping.provenance: ArcGIS FeatureServer layer's native objectid; GeoJSON response also exposed the same identity as feature id; sample ids 55, 118, 140.

nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect the current official service, verify Ribeira locality alignment and citywide coverage, and qualify the objectid identity/CRS behavior before any adapter or runtime consideration.
